As we promised yesterday - here we come with the [b]newest, end of the season update[/b] for Gold Mining Simulator!

🔧[Fixed] Light system trailer now has improved textures, making text on it readable.

[*] Improved game performance in the town.
[*] Adjusted the center of gravity of the machines.
[*] Increased vehicle power.
[*] Improved stability and traction.
[*] Adjusted the pivot point.

[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2900730/Gold_Mining_Simulator__Mini_Mining_Machines/

First and foremost, we would like to unveil that our beloved game will adopt a completely new name, one that captures the spirit and character of what it means to be a true gold prospector. We know you've been eagerly anticipating this update, so we are pleased to announce that we expect to roll it out in the first half of the second quarter of [b]2[/b]024. Get ready for new challenges, new discoveries, and new adventures!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.7.0
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Miners,[/b]
Today we will be releasing a hotfix that address an invisible quad in the part shop issue and as well update to the steam cloud saving. Now steam cloud shouldn't turn OFF automatically after exiting a game. We've made a small tutorial on how to properly enable steam cloud and how to do backup for your game files.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/1e89b51785c419c839b28a6d53f63d0bcdae8d87.png[/img]

[h3][b]Please before turning ON steam cloud saves make sure to backup your save files!![/b][/h3]

[b]How to create a backup for your save files:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Open file explorer and go to: %localappdata%low\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Saves
[*] Copy the entire folder called "Saves" to your desktop - [b]DO NOT CUT IT, JUST COPY![/b]
[*] That's it, now follow the other steps to enable Steam Cloud saves
[/olist]
[b]How to enable Steam Cloud Saving:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Go to your Steam library
[*] Right click on a Gold Rush: The Game then click properties
[*] In the General tab you need to check the steam cloud option
[*] You can now exit the tab
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/c3b490815b5c65cfcfc7028f9e101cc20ee38eb4.png[/img]

Now it should automatically put your save files that you have on your local storage to the steam cloud, and it will update it every time you will exit your game. If it's says that the steam cloud is not synchronised just click on it and click retry synchronising, now it should upload properly.

If you encounter any issues please contact us on Discord server and we will try to help you. Thank you!

notes.title: The Steam Workshop Update + Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
[h3]Howdy, Miners![/h3]
We're kicking off this Summer Sale with a brand new addition to the game. From now you can use [b]the Steam Workshop[/b] for all of your skin-changing business. But what does it mean, exactly?

[previewyoutube=X_vGToGT2bA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Freedom of skins![/h2]
[list]
[*] Countless free skins made by our lovely community
[*] Comfortable skin browsing and installation
[*] A chance for your own creations to be downloaded by players all around the world!
[/list]
You can access all of that by going to the game's community 'Workshop' tab.

[h2]Free Pickup Skin[/h2]
Especially for this occasion Woody, our team's top mechanic, prepared a free Day 1 skin, ready to be applied onto your rusty pickup trucks:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2132954326
[h2]Custom Skins Guide[/h2]
If you fancy yourself a talented creator, be sure to grab the custom skin guide which you can find linked in our changelog:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/451340/announcements/detail/2502261702436831577

[h2]Steam Summer Sale[/h2]
If your friends are still staying at home, missing all the fun that comes from digging in the dirt... let them know that we're [u][b]50% off![/b][/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/451340/Gold_Rush_The_Game/

And as always...
Let's get digging! ⛏️

notes.title: Consoles update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Miners![/h1]

As promised - more info about X1 and PS4 ports below - there’s also something for PC fans!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=505Ztf6bMgw

What to expect from [b]X1[/b] and [b]PS4[/b] versions?
[list]
[*][b]1:1[/b] port of gold mining experience from PC,
[*]entire gameplay content released so far,
[*][b]2 years of updates[/b] and fixes already in.
[/list]
As you might know the end of the year in game dev industry is pretty intense. Our studio is making sure that the upcoming release is thoroughly checked for any possible issues. Quality improvements should be also experienced in PC version. 

What delays us the most is continuous synchronization between living PC game and the upcoming ports. We know that we tentatively announced ports for [u]Q4 2019[/u], but there are [b]2 essential steps[/b] ahead of us:
[list]
[*]Certification testing (mandatory for publishing the game on consoles)
[*]Setting release date with all partners (not only publishers – it’s a licensed product after all)
[/list]

Those are the main reasons why we have to delay the release ([b]unofficially to Q1 2020[/b]) – and for that we are truly sorry. We are totally aware that you are waiting for console version for such a long time – we can promise that you’ll be the first to know if there’s ANY new info.

Be sure that we will continue to support PC version and leaderboard system. You keep sending us so many amazing ideas, it would be shame not to use them to create more content!

And again - thank you for your continuous support – [i][u]there’s no Gold Rush without you[/u][/i]!

P.S. There’s [b]Xmas gift[/b] for everyone with PC version - [u][b]we planned Free DLC event with one of our existing DLCs[/b][/u] – please stay tuned for more info.

notes.title: Update 1.5.5 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/24a60ce429250c3c9c8e4ca8f9587207d1a3e7c1.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hello Miners![/b][/h1]
Update 1.5.5 is LIVE and it brings:
[list]
[*] Updated DigTube
[*] Plenty bug and crash fixes
[/list]
With the updated video and brand new text versions of DigTube, you will be able to take the full advantage of your gold mining operation. Multiple fixes should make the experience more enjoyable.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated DigTube.
- Added new categories.
- Updated the layout.
- Added option to display the video version or the text version.
[*] Increased friction on Wash Plants' ladders to reduce the character's sliding.
[*] Added Fuel Consumption parameter to the Store.
[*] Exiting the vehicle should no longer be possible if the character would interfere with collisions or get outside the terrain.
[*] Slightly lowered the ground level under Duplex Jigs' on Nighthawk Valley claim to make it easier to remove buckets.
[*] Reworked Pickup Truck's collision system.
[*] Modified collisions of multiple elements in the game.
[*] Removed several bushes with hitboxes, which are no longer needed after the collisions' rework.
[*] Miner's moss' washing out sound should now be working.
[*] Added missing indicators in Tutorial's Stage 3 and fixed the incorrect ones.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby some LODs wouldn't display lights when observing them from the distance.
[*] Corrected vehicles' lights on various LODs.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Pickup Truck's engine would sound differently after loading the game, which was saved while the Pickup Truck was working.
[*] Fixed Excavator's working lights texture.
[*] Fixed machines reverse lights' flashing.
[*] Corrected digging sounds.
[*] Corrected Wash Plant Springs' reinforced texture in the Warehouse.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby new Miner's Moss would be filled in 100%.
[*] Added quest task to Tutorial's Stage 3, which requires players to connect the water hose to the Big Water Pump.
[*] Other minor Tutorial fixes.
[*] Corrected factory chimney's smoke emitter on Old Arnold's claim.
[*] Fixed Store's list scrolling on the gamepad.
[*] Cash register's list is now scaled down in the Warehouse if the list is longer then the visible area.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby gamepad would not work after exiting the Machines Store.
[*] Fixed the renting UI dot issue in Machine's Store.
[*] Corrected rusted van's (located near the Bank) hitboxes.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the water would flow in items placed in Pickup Truck's bed after loading the save.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the small shovel would appear in the bucket placed in Pickup Truck's bed after loading the save.
[*] Blocked machines' rotation when using Fast Travel.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Miners Mosses were displayed as broken.
[*] Improved readability of the Internet Radio popup.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the player could select Fast Travel waypoints on the map on the gamepad even if they were not purchased.
[*] Modified the description of Easy Washplant Placing and Random Events while choosing the difficulty level.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the rented machine's price would differ every day instead of being fixed for the whole renting period.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the Pickup Truck would turn invisible after losing the hood and driving to Old Arnold's claim.
[*] Added animation to Start All and Stop All buttons in the Generator.
[*] Added possibility to exit laptop tabs on the keyboard by pressing [Esc].
[*] Fixed Easy Wash Plant Placing issues with certain parts that would not snap correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Fuel Tank's brake wouldn't work on hills.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Transport Crate's physics would behave incorrectly when driving over them with Pickup Truck.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby quick-loading the game while panning could cause the game to freeze.
[*] Added Excavator's Leaderboard skin to Top 10 Leaderboards Season 3 players' account.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Worker's Hire and Upgrade buttons could be selected despite having no Workers.
[*] The prompt informing about the Wash Plant's Mats or Buckets being full is no longer displayed if there are Workers assigned to them.
[*] When opening the map it will now always center on the Pickup Truck if the player is inside it.
[*] Corrected machines' light textures.
[*] Corrected Excavators' and Frankenstein's collisions with claims borders.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Total Cost on the laptop would reflect the machines' price.
[*] The snow texture is no longer displayed on several items, including Small Trailer's Wheel, Water Splitter, Matt Holder, etc.
[*] Added shadows to School building.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Main Menu's upper tabs would not be highlighted.
[*] The Head Lamp is no longer turned off after entering and exiting the vehicle.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby active selection in Lease and Buy tabs would skip an element on the gamepad.
[*] All driveable machines now have a direction arrow on the Map.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the broken Water Tower would have status icons displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the drill could break despite having Machine Failures option disabled.
[*] Added the option to sort elements in the Laptop Stores.
[*] Reorganization of certain items' location in Store tabs.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby changing the active Worker on the machine would cause the game to freeze.
[*] The controls for switching tools on the gamepad should now be working correctly.
[*] Added option to sort machines in the Machine Store.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby a quest marker would disappear upon loading the game.
[*] Added Reinforced Hydraulic Rotator to the Store.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby renting Machines in the Heavy Equipment Park would be blocked on the gamepad.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby pouring water from the Bucket to the Hog Pan Pump wouldn't wash out the dirt.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Bank loan wouldn't work on the gamepad.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the Toolbox would appear when pressing [Z] on the keyboard while using a vehicle.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby it was possible to pick up and replace Miners Moss from the Sluicebox without removing Miners Grill First.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Engine's sound wouldn't play after quick-loading.
[*] Corrected information about Easy Washplant Placing when starting a new game on Normal and Hard. It is now marked as "Off/Blocked".
[*] Disabled all remaining Steam Cloud Synch options, that could cause the game to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby lifting the Shaker wouldn't be possible when attaching cables on top.
[*] Some Tutorial quest values are now calculated based on maximum summer prices, to avoid situation in which the player gathers less money than necessary to purchase all the equipment.
[*] Fixed an issue on the laptop whereby Used Slots counter on the claim would reset each time the player makes a purchase.
[*] Added marker to the Tutorial's Small Water Pump task.
[*] Removed unnecessary consumption values from certain items in the Store.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby pressing [Z] while creating a Save would open keybindings bar.
[*] Corrected Low Voltage Extension Cord texture.
[*] Corrected Handbrake prompt.
[*] Corrected some windows' textures.
[*] Added missing prompt to the Tutorials' last prologue task.
[*] Darkened tire marks on claims to fit the others.
[*] fixed an issue whereby Store Quantity values would remain visible after the purchase.
[*] Blocked possibility to enable Mouse Digging Mode in Tutorial's prologue.
[*] Other minor UI fixes.
[*] Updated translations.
[/list]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]

[h1][b]Hello Miners![/b][/h1]
Update 1.5.4 is LIVE and it brings:
[list]
[*] Light System Trailer
[*] Leaderboards Season 3
[*] Workers Experience
[*] Store Sales

[/list]

https://youtu.be/fXSP7OB5uEQ
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/cd38913e6a681f0da8c7087fd0b6d0b1d6689588.png[/img]
[h1]Light System Trailer[/h1]
Dig the gold all day and all night with the brand new Light System Trailer. Auto-leveling mobile diesel trailer will let you extend and rotate its arm to light up your claim.
The extendable arm has 2 thresholds. The second threshold (>50%) is available when the trailer is in the deploy mode.  The trailer can't be attached to the pickup in the deploy mode. It is possible to rotate the lights in any mode. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/212394ec7cac92231b45b42684d127be68b7adb0.png[/img]
[h1]Leaderboards Season 3[/h1]
Ready your shovel and prepare for an adventure. Show your gold mining skills and compete in two leaderboard modes: Max Gold (the total amount of Gold dug), Season Gold (the best Gold per Season ration). There is a price to dig for: the unique Excavator skin.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/5ca49bc00f6beeaddacc857d8c7f1796cdfa6730.png[/img]
[h1]Workers Experience[/h1]
Workers can now get more skilled with time! For each working day at your gold mine (counted on midnight), they gain +1% performance. When the worker reaches maximum performance for a particular Tier, the Upgrade option is unlocked, which allows upgrading the worker to the next Tier. The Upgrade itself doesn't increase the performance.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/f0af614097386c956e51614538c0882b89f19fe0.jpg[/img]
[h1]Store Sales[/h1]
Once in every 1-3 days, a random part in each store will be on sale. The sales are independent for both stores (machines and equipment) and can happen on different days. Items are on sale only in physical stores (in other words: there will be no discounts on the laptop).
Discount range:
• Machine Store - 10-25%
• Equipment Store - 15-30%
Players will be informed about the sale via prompt (upper left) with information about items name and discount.

[h1]Full changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Light System Trailer (described above).
[*] Leaderboards Season 3 started.
[*] Added Store Sales (described above).
[*] Added Worker's Experience (described above).
[*] Retraining Workers is no longer random. When selecting the Retrain option, a specializations list will appear. Each specialization has a different price - the more complex the machine, the higher the price. If the worker was on a higher Tier than the 1st one, he/she will lose the percentage of performance equal to one Tier.
[*] Added option to rent machines. The daily cost of renting is equal to the 1/25 of the machine's current price. To return the machine, the player must sell it.
[*] Added possibility to order drill services on random spots via Laptop.
[*] Added possibility to sleep for a particular number of hours.
[*] If not used, Batteries now lose durability during winter.
[*] Added maximum length value to hoses' UI icons.
[*] Icons of broken parts now also appear over broken parts, which lay on the ground.
[*] Reworked particle effects of campfire and machines smoke.
[*] Reordered some tutorial tasks.
[*] Removed the branch near the campfire at the Old Arnold claim.
[*] Fixes of achievements, which rely on statistics.
[*] Fixed gold nuggets bug, which prevented some of them from being picked during panning.
[*] Fixed Warehouse checkout bug on the laptop.
[*] Fixed Pickup Truck's reversing lights, which worked when the engine was off.
[*] Corrected valve's turning sound.
[*] UI fixes.
[*] Added unique Dump Truck skin to TOP10 Leaderboards players accounts.
[*] Updated Unity engine.
[*] Updated translations.
[*] Updated credits.
[/list]
[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We'd like to again thank all beta testers, whose specific reports and clever suggestions allowed us to make this update even better. Another round for applause for community translators, who keep the game localized in your languages. You're awesome!

notes.title: AMD crashes since last update - help us solve the issue!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Players![/b][/h1]

We are aware that some of you might be experiencing crashes since the last Update. From your reports, we are able to suspect it has something to do with AMD Radeon GPUs and new Unity update. We're now in contact with AMD to resolve this issue.
To help us deal with the problem, we'd kindly ask those of you who have AMD Radeon GPUs to send us an e-mail at bugs@goldrush-thegame.com (Title: [i]AMD Crash[/i]) with the following files:
- output_log, 
- error.log, 
- crash.dmp,
- video of the crash.

Here's how to find them:

[b]Output_log[/b]
• Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
• Enter the following without the quotes '%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame'

[b]Error.log, crash.dmp[/b]
Once the game crashes, it will provide a log file, which can be found by following the steps below:
• Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
• Enter the following without the quotation marks: "%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Crashes"
• The crash folder will have the name of a date for example - 2018-02-12_151020 
Important: restarting the game will delete the crash log files.

or alternatively:
• Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
• Enter the following without the quotation marks: "%temp%\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Crashes"

[b]Video of the crash[/b]
Videos can be recorded with popular recording software such as OBS, Xsplit, AMD ReLive, etc.
You can upload the videos on wetransfer.com (or other services) and send us the link.

Thanks in advance for your help! With such files, it will be easier for us to help.

[b]Cheers![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.5.3 is LIVE - Leaderboards 2, new item, tool, worker, reinforced parts, and more!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Gold Miners![/h1]
Update 1.5.3 is [b]LIVE[/b] and it brings:
[list]
[*]Leaderboards Season 2
[*]Overseer
[*]Reinforced Parts
[*]Transport Crate
[*]Parts Analyzer
[*]New random events
[*]Balance changes
[*]Internet radio integration
[*]And more!
[/list]

[h1]Watch the trailer:[/h1]
https://youtu.be/mJvlKaZNAZo

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/095ed477482fba6a5c96b1b70bc6832873fcd440.gif[/img]
[h1]Leaderboards Season 2[/h1]
Compete against other Players to become one of the greatest mine bosses! Now with the new [i]Seasonal Gold[/i] parameter.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/b906a29174ecd4313cc9ca6516057ea04f096f00.gif[/img]
[h1]Overseer[/h1]
The new worker is here to help you manage your gold mine more effectively. Get notifications when parts reach low durability or when Wash Plant elements (like mats) are full. Find out more about Tier 1-3 effects below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/6486d92ba12caace92a37a96a2016a0b6e72ca82.gif[/img]
[h1]Reinforced Parts[/h1]
All breakable parts received their reinforced substitutes. They last longer, but come with greater costs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/308dc783c9987c3160458e8e529fec0598d6705c.gif[/img]
[h1]Transport Crate[/h1]
Meet the Transport Crate - the greatest convenience item since the invention of the microwave. With this new equipment, you will be able to hold and carry multiple items at once.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/9d3f8bd65db91f94742dfac63ae7ffe644e49b97.gif[/img]
[h1]Parts Analyzer[/h1]
Allows you to easily check the current durability of selected parts. Simply approach the working machine and select Parts Analyzer.

[h1]Internet Radio integration[/h1]
Listen to your favorite streaming radios while digging!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1714102451
[h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the reinforced set of breakable parts, which have greater durability, but also a greater price. They can be distinguished by a different color. Players can now choose to use more expensive parts, which will last longer. Reinforced parts are available in the Store.
[*]Added Wooden Crates. Players can use them to carry multiple items at the same time.
[*]Added new Tool: Parts Analyzer, which can be used to check the durability of the part it points at.
[*]Added new Worker: Overseer (see Tier 1-3 effects below).
[*]Added new random events (see the full list below).
[*]Added internet radio integration. Check out the guide above to learn how to activate it.
[*]Pickup Truck is now moved next to the player after being teleported to the Hotel when Permafrost hits.
[*]Pickup Truck no longer breaks when the Permafrost hits.
[*]The Headlight lightning now works as Flashlight, but with greater brightness. You can carry the equipment with the Headlight on.
[*]Removed Flashlight from the toolbar.
[*]Changed default Tools' changing to mouse's scroll wheel.
[*]Magnetite Separator stops processing dirt when the bucket is full (just like the Gold Nuggetator).
[*]Added 12-hour game time display option in the Settings -> Game -> Clock Time.
[*]Added information about the fuel consumption to the Store.
[*]Added a new button to the Generator: Start All.
[*]Workers are paid at midnight.
[*]Loan daily payments are collected at midnight.
[*]Statistics are checked at midnight, no matter at what time they are displayed to the Player.
[*]The randomization of workers in Retrain Workers option now works as drawing a new one (from the pool of available machines).
[*]Added the possibility of the Fuel Station running out of fuel.
[*]Added prompt informing about the engine being turned off when trying to use Excavator's arm.
[*]Made it possible to enter the Power Generator without jumping.
[*]Changed Map's moving icons.
[*]Added new valves to Water Towers. 
[*]Adjusted pan's collider to fit the bowl more accurately.
[*]Added Fuel Tank's opening sound.
[*]Added the possibility to open Fuel Tank's cap.
[*]Small Electric Water Pump's cap is now automatically opened before refueling.
[*]Added closing animations to lids and caps.
[*]Added new notification when the engine has been turned off but the lights are still on.
[*]Changed Magnetite's selling prompt text.
[*]Reduced the required amount of cables being attached in one of the Tutorial tasks from 4 to 3.
[*]Changed Wash Plant's elements snapping during setup on the Easy Mode. The correct rotation of the element is no longer necessary.
[*]Added more markers in the Tutorial to the Trommel, the Bank during the [*]Claim upgrade task, the Front-End Loader, Duplex Jig buckets, and ST Sluicebox buckets.
[*]Added new Tutorial task, which requires Players to sell the Gold Bar in the Tutorial.
[*]Changed wording in keybindings for the Excavator: one part of the Bucket has been renamed to Thumb, Big Arm to Boom, and Small Arm to Stick.
[*]Adjusted tree branch on Old Arnold's small digging site.
[*]Added Tool icons and associated keybindings to the in-game Show Controls menu.
[*]Limited fuel stations nozzle's hose length.
[*]Disabled random events in the tutorial.
[*]ST Sluicebox is now the first equipment to be set up in the tutorial.
[*]Pickup Truck no longer uses fuel in the tutorial until the first refueling.
[*]Added Romanian Pickup Truck skin.
[*]Added Leaderboards Pickup Truck skin to Top10 Players accounts.
[/list]

[h1][b]Leaderboards Season 2[/b][/h1]
For the second season of gold mining competition, we are adding a new parameter: best Gold per Season ratio ([i]Seasonal Gold[/i]). The game will count the highest amount of gold dug during any of the in-game seasons (full year). The score will be updated whenever Player gets a better score, so it will be continuously updated during the first in-game season, and then it will start updating again when Player reaches better score than during the first in-game season.
In other words, Players will now be competing in two leaderboards ([i]Max Gold[/i] and [i]Seasonal Gold[/i]), and the TOP10 lists may differ depending on the parameter. Winners will again be rewarded with a new special vehicle skin.
[list]
[*] In Leaderboards Mode, the gold gathered in buckets will be counted towards the current season's  Seasonal Gold value. This will prevent gold from being stored in buckets for the subsequent seasons in order to get better results.
[*] Added option to switch the display between to parameters: Overall Amount of Gold Dug and Gold/Season Ratio.
[*] Leaderboards are now scrollable.
[/list]

[h1][b]Overseer:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Tier 1:[/b] Shows notification when the part reaches 0.3 durability. Adds a Yellow version of the outline when below 0.3 and not yet destroyed (if Overseer's performance equals 100%). Prevents equipment theft random event from happening.
[*][b]Tier 2:[/b] Adds Red ray over the destroyed machine to be more noticeable from far away. Increases the Outline visibility range of destroyed/almost destroyed parts by x2,5 (if Overseer's performance equals 100%). Decreases the chance of bear attacking the cables and workers by 50% (if Overseer's performance equals 100%).
[*][b]Tier 3:[/b] Adds notification when any element of the Wash Plant system is full. Makes parts outline gradually change their color depending on their current durability. Decreases the chance of bear attacking the cables and workers by 100% (if Overseer's performance equals 100%).
[/list]

[h1][b]New random events[/b][/h1]
Every day there's a 5% chance that one of the new random events will occur at 4 am (or when the Player gets up). Each of the events has its own chance factor of happening, meaning that if a random event is triggered, some events will be more likely to occur than others:
[list]
[*]Theft of a single random part from a machine - 10%.
[*]Destruction of a single part from a machine - 10%.
[*]Theft of the fuel (emptying the fuel tank) - 15%.
[*]A single random employee quits - 25%.
[*]Theft of 5% of gathered Gold (gathered during a single day) - 10%.
[*]Theft of 10% of earned Money - 0% (the event can no longer happen).
[*]Laptop's malfunction - it does not work for a single day - 25%.
[*]No fuel on the Fuel Station - not possible to use it for a single day - 5%.
[/list]
In other words: there is a 5% chance every day that a random event will occur. If it does, there is a 25% chance that it will be a laptop's malfunction, 10% chance that it will be a Part's Theft, etc.

[h1][b]Balance:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Decreased Bank loan interest rate.
[*]Decreased Excavator's fuel usage.
[*]Adjusted Excavators' and Front-End Loader's buckets. Big Excavator's bucket has a capacity of 2 Small Excavators' buckets. Front-End Loader's bucket has a capacity of 4 Small Excavators' buckets.
[*]Increased Front-End Loader's fuel usage.
[*]Increased Big Excavator's movement by 15%.
[*]Increased Big Excavator's hydraulic speed by 10%.
[*]Decreased Big Excavator's price.
[*]Decreased Front-End Loader's reverse movement speed by 20%.
[*]Increased Front-End Loader's price.
[*]Decreased Bulldozer's fuel consumption.
[*]Decreased Bulldozer's price.
[*]Increased T3/T4/T5 machine prices.
[*]Increased Frankenstein's price.
[*]Decreased Dump Truck's price.
[*]Increased Excavator Teeth's durability.
[*]Increased Wheels' durability.
[*]Increased Hydraulic Hoses' durability (for the Bulldozer, Small Excavator, and Big Excavator).
[*]Increased Battery's durability.
[*]Increased Magnetite Separator's Hose durability.
[*]Increased Wave Table's Jets durability.
[*]Increased River's water pressure distance.
[*]Increased Blacksmith upgrades' price.
[*]Increased Water's price.
[*]Increased Gold Nugettator's price.
[*]Increased the amount of gold at Rich Spots on claims.
[*]Decreased the amount of gold at regular spots on claims.
[*]Increased claims' rent prices (except Old Arnold's).
[*]Increased claims' prices.
[*]Decreased claims' rent provision rate (except Old Arnold's).

[h1][b]Fixes & Optimization:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added culling to machines, which are out of sight (optimization).

[b]Random events:[/b]

[list]

[*]Destruction of a single part from a machine - 10%.
[*]Theft of the fuel (emptying the fuel tank) - 15%.
[*]A single random employee quits - 25%.
[*]Theft of 5% of gathered Gold (during a single day) - 10%.
[*]Theft of 10% of earned Money - 0% (the event can no longer happen).

[*]No fuel on the Fuel Station - not possible to use it for a single day - 5%.
[/list]

The new worker is here to help you manage your gold mine more effectively. Get notifications when parts reach low durability or when Wash Plant elements (like mats) are full. Find out more about Tier 1-3 effects below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/6486d92ba12caace92a37a96a2016a0b6e72ca82.gif[/img]

All breakable parts received their reinforced substitutes. They last longer, but come with greater costs.

Meet the Transport Crate - the greatest convenience item since the invention of the microwave. With this new equipment, you will be able to hold and carry multiple items at once.

[*]Added Wooden Crates. Players can use them to carry multiple items at the same time.
[*]Added new Tool: Parts Analyzer, which can be used to check the durability of the part it points at.
[*]Added new Worker: Overseer (see Tier 1-3 effects below).
[*]Added new random events (see the full list below).
[*]Pickup Truck is now moved next to the player after being teleported to the Hotel when Permafrost hits.
[*]Pickup Truck no longer breaks when the Permafrost hits.
[*]The Headlight lightning now works as Flashlight, but with greater brightness. You can carry the equipment with the Headlight on.
[*]Removed Flashlight from the toolbar.
[*]Magnetite Separator stops processing dirt when the bucket is full (just like the Gold Nuggetator).
[*]Added 12-hour game time display option in the Settings -> Game -> Clock Time.
[*]Added information about fuel consumption to the Store.
[*]Added a new button to the Generator: Start All.
[*]Workers are paid at midnight.
[*]Loan daily payments are collected at midnight.
[*]Statistics are checked at midnight, no matter at what time they are displayed to the Player.
[*]The randomization of workers in Retrain Workers option now works as drawing a new one (from the pool of available machines).
[*]Added the possibility of the Fuel Station running out of fuel.
[*]Added prompt informing about the engine being turned off when trying to use Excavator's arm.
[*]Changed Map's moving icons.
[*]Added new valves to Water Towers. 
[*]Adjusted pan's collider to fit the bowl more accurately.
[*]Added Fuel Tank's opening sound.
[*]Added the possibility to open Fuel Tank's cap.
[*]Small Electric Water Pump's cap is now automatically opened before refueling.
[*]Added closing animations to lids and caps.
[*]Added new notification when the engine has been turned off but the lights are still on.
[*]Changed Magnetite's selling prompt text.
[*]Reduced the required amount of cables being attached in one of the Tutorial tasks from 4 to 3.
[*]Changed Wash Plant's elements snapping during setup on the Easy Mode. The correct rotation of the element is no longer necessary.
[*]Added more markers in the Tutorial to the Trommel, the Bank during the [*]Claim upgrade task, the Front-End Loader, Duplex Jig buckets, and ST Sluicebox buckets.

[*]Added Romanian Pickup Truck skin.
[*]Added Leaderboards Pickup Truck skin to Top10 Players accounts.
[/list]

[h1][b]Overseer:[/b][/h1]
[list]

Increases the Outline visibility range of destroyed/almost destroyed parts by x2,5 (if Overseer's performance equals 100%). Decreases the chance of bear attacking the cables and workers by 50% (if Overseer's performance equals 100%).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/71d2ad57d57d34072fdbda3e0ee17fcfdad91241.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Miners![/h1]
Thanks to your prompt reports, we were able to publish a HotFix. See the list of changes below:

• Fixed Leaderboard bug with old save files, that allowed some players to enter the ranking with a score drawn from Hard Mode save.
• Fixed bug with inability to turn off the Mobile Water Tank.
• Removed IRL time column from Leaderboards.
• Added IRL time values to Friends tab in Leaderboards.
• Fixed bug with inability to pick up Stories.
• Increased Frankenstein's Container capacity by 1.5x.
• Increased Frankenstein's belt speed by 2x.
• Removed campfire collision on Old Arnold's Claim. Also: a wild tree branch appears!
• Increased space for end-of-the-season Gold Jars in tents.
• Corrected visibility of arrows in Pay off loan screen on laptop.
• Fixed issue with Magnetite Separator not being transferred when placed on Big Trailer during Fast Travel.
• Corrected Leaderboards Gold Nugget text in Main Menu. Now it states, that Gold Nugget is enabled in Leaderboards Mode.
• Fixed incorrect name of Sluicebox Crate when using a Small Shovel.

[h1]Cheers to you![/h1]

notes.title: Update 1.5.2 is LIVE - Leaderboards
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/5697c94cb4969ddb27d4d19f11a5260a181087cf.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello Gold Miners![/h1]
Update 1.5.2 is LIVE and it brings:
[list]
[*]Leaderboards
[*]New and updated national skins for Pickup Truck
[*]and more!
[/list]
Full [b]changelog[/b] below.

[h1]Watch trailer:[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dc0sjU1LPSc

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/8f8ce2bacf7fd72c5b84632a7af7276b17d1d294.png[/img]
[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]
Just as Gold Rush TV Series mine bosses you can now compare your gold totals with other players in Leaderboards!
Start playing in new Leaderboards mode and earn your place in rankings.
[b]Good to know:[/b]
[list]
[*]Balance values are drawn from the New Normal Mode.
[*]Player's score shows the total amount of gold dug and real-life playing time spent to achieve it.
[*]Score sums the amount of gold dug in consecutive in-game seasons.
[*]Leaderboards will be reset from time to time, but the history of previous seasons will remain (top players + player's score).
[*]You can get a special reward (vehicle skin) for being one of the top players in Leaderboards.
[*]Save files from non-active (reset) Leaderboards will become Normal Mode saves and you will be able to continue playing on that save file.
[*]It's not possible to share save file from active Leaderboards.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/619e3fdbbe2a9837a69b5de6e73d4a1e97c21956.gif[/img]
[h1]New and updated national skins for Pickup Truck[/h1]
Did you know, that most of translations are made by our awesome community members? ❤ We want to appreciate their hard work and devotion, by adding new Pickup Truck vehicle skins.
ps There will be at least one more added to the game in one of the upcoming updates: Romanian. @Jimmy - we didn't forget about you!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Leaderboards mode.
[*]Added Leaderboards tab in Leaderboards mode for players to compare their total amount of gold dug.
[*]Added new and updated existing Pickup Truck's national flag vehicle skins.
[*]Changed balance values for Normal Mode. It used to have the same values as Easy Mode, but now it's more balanced between Easy and Hard Modes.  Players will have a single opportunity to decide, whether they want to switch to New Normal Mode or switch to Easy Mode (which has the same balance values as previous Normal Mode).
[*]Workers now only apply to work on machines, which player currently possesses.
[*]Blocked possibility to quick-load the game when it's saving.
[*]Increased Wave Table's capacity.
[*]Doubled Dump Truck's and Conveyor Belt's capacity.
[*]Increased Front-End Loader's hydraulic speed.
[*]All purchased machines start with 20% fuel.
[*]Added Mechanic icon above items that are currently being repaired by a Mechanic.
[*]Added provision for gold panning and washing dirt in the Wavetable when in Town.
[*]Frankenstein's Belt icon turns off on HUD when the fuel runs out in the second engine.
[*]Added new prompt informing about an empty fuel tank in Frankenstein's second engine.
[*]Increased Map's zoom in value.
[*]Updated Gold Rush posters and banners in Town and tent.
[*]Changed save files description to include difficulty level and season.
[*]Default keybindings are now displayed in Tutorial's prompts.
[*]Reversed Excavator's scoop keys in Tutorial's prompt.
[*]Added new Excavator digging prompts in the Tutorial.
[*]Changed prompt's background.
[*]Added background to Pressure System texts.
[*]Vehicle paint UI changes.
[*]Workers UI changes.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Front-End Loader's bucket sticking to Dump Truck's bed.
[*]Mobile Washplant's indicators should no longer disappear after leaving the claim and going back from Town.
[*]Fixed Conveyor Belt's infinite energy exploit.
[*]Fixed bug with River not filling when the player is sleeping.
[*]Corrected Mobile Water Tank's button animation.
[*]Fixed camera's stutter when moving and rotating the camera.
[*]Fixed Pickup Truck's LOD.
[*]Fixed Hog Pan Core's worker bug - worker is now increasing the efficiency (amount of gold) instead of filling hog pan mats faster.
[*]Fixed inability to finish the tutorial if unlocking all laptop tabs on 1$ mode before receiving the appropriate quest task.
[*]Fixed bug with birds' sounds not being played during summer.
[*]Fixed Mobile Water Tank's steering.
[*]Fixed inability to switch camera and vehicle when reaching Season 10.
[*]Fixed Magnetite Separator's particles.
[*]Fixed prompt's issue with the first gold nugget having 0.66 at the end.
[*]Fixed bug with Sluicebox Grates disappearing after loading the game if not attached to Sluicebox.
[*]Fixed End-of-the-year summary statistics bug.
[*]Fixed bug with 1,111 value on Small Water Pump.
[*]Fixed walking sound in the night on asphalt.
[*]Fixed driving sound in the night on asphalt.
[*]Fixed wheel's sound - it no longer plays broken wheel's sound when repaired.
[*]Fixed Magnetite Trailer exploit with unprocessed dirt.
[*]Fixed Sluicebox Grate LOD.
[*]Fixed sound of nugget dropped to a jar.
[*]Fixed Excavator's Arm sound.
[*]Fixed notifications prompt.
[*]Fixed Drill's LOD - it should no longer glow
[*]Fixed Mobile Washplant's blinking icons.
[*]Fixed fuel usage bug.
[*]Gamepad UI fixes
[*]Minor optimization improvements.
[*]Other Leaderboards UI changes & fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We'd like to thank all beta testers, who helped us polish this update. Your suggestions were well-aimed and your reports - specific. You're awesome!

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
If you stumbled upon a bug in Gold Rush, please report it to us, by sending an e-mail to bugs@goldrush-thagame.com or by starting a new thread on Steam discussions:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/2/
Your reviews are extremely important to us. If you haven't done it, we'd be grateful if you could leave a review on Gold Rush Steam page.

[h1]Now let's get digging![/h1]

notes.notes:

[h1]Hello Prospectors![/h1]
Update 1.5.1.11018 is LIVE and it brings:
[list]
[*]Balance Changes (improved digging)
[*]Tutorial Improvements
[*]Bug Fixes
[*]And more.
[/list]
Full [b]changelog[/b] below.

[h1]IMPORTANT:[/h1] We had to [b]temporarily disable the Steam Cloud Synchronization[/b] due to an issue with the deleted save files reported by some Players. We are now investigating the issue and hope to fix it in the coming days. For now, please remember to copy your save files if you wish to transfer them to another drive.
Here's how to find them:
[list]
[*]Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
[*]Enter the following without the quotes: '%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Saves'
[*]Copy the content of the entire folder.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed Excavator's digging parameters. Digging feeling has changed.
[*]Changed Front-End Loader's digging parameters. Digging feeling has changed.
[*]Reduced Front-End ability to push dirt.
[*]Changed starting fuel of any machine to 20%.
[*]All washplant containers fill evenly at the same rate.
[*]Increased prices of T4 & T5 machines.
[*]Reduced claim upgrade prices.
[*]Changed shop prices.
[*]Changed machine park prices.
[*]Changed Seasons' price multiplier.
[*]Adjusted destroyable Parts lifetime.
[*]Changed the multiplier of failures during Summer and Winter.
[*]Lowered the multiplier of parts durability during Seasons on Hard Mode.
[*]Lowered the multiplier of Fuel price on Hard Mode.
[*]Other balance changes.
[/list]

[h1]Tutorial:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Tier 2 tutorial.
[*]Added Tier 3 assembly tutorial.
[*]Added possibility to end the tutorial at any time (currently only on the keyboard).
[*]Added new tutorial steps to the existing quest tasks.
[*]Changed order of Small Excavator and Mobile Washplant quest tasks in the tutorial.
[*]Changed several tutorial quest task texts.
[*]Added new yellow markers (quest task indicators) to better guide the Player.
[*]Added more godrays (yellow beams) on the road to the Old Arnold claim.
[*]Adjusted existing yellow markers (quest task indicators) positions.
[*]Added yellow markers, which are displayed in the corner of the screen, if the godray is not visible in Players' sight.
[*]Changed headers of tutorial tasks (T1, T2, etc.).
[*]Disabled possibility to use the bucket on machines, that are not in quest task.
[*]Changed Tutorial starting season from Spring to Summer.
[*]Added new task after smelting first gold bar. Players are now required to get 20k dollars.
[*]Fueling quest tasks are skipped if the player has full fuel tanks.
[*]Quest tasks, which require to collect a specific amount of gold, are skipped if the player is playing with 1$ Mode enabled.
[*]Disabled the day summary at the beginning of the tutorial.
[*]Other minor tutorial fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Other:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed Stock graph in the Bank to better reflect the changes after Four Seasons Cycle Update. As each Season has 10 days, the Graph is now divided into 40 days.
[*]Name of the highlighted item is now displayed.

notes.title: Gold Rush: The Game - Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/cf74983acc8bc86dcff166d33bb02ead94f13118.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Players![/h1]
Gold Rush: The Game is celebrating it's 1st anniversary with a huge Anniversary Update, featuring:
[list]
[*]Four Seasons Cycle
[*]Achievements
[*]Reversed Tutorial
[*]and more!
[/list]

Full [b]changelog[/b] below.

[h1]Release trailer[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jCLzQsaKpNQ

[h1]Four Seasons Cycle[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/a52ca659afcfd02b6c23173a751a314161f06f0b.gif[/img]
Experience harsh Alaskan Winter and get excited about new gold mining season with the first Spring breeze.

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/86030107f49f08e7acc5e32046d83dcd6c49ad6d.gif[/img]
Show off your gold mining experience with Steam achievements. Can you get them all?

[h1]Reversed Tutorial[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/a11e368687c7d3f860413a7119d266373e743ca9.gif[/img]
Start with all the best toys and... see for yourself!


[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Seasons - gameplay is now affected by weather conditions:
- Spring,
- Summer,
- Autumn,
- Winter.
(description of Seasons and weather conditions below)
[*]Spring, Summer, and Autumn last 10 in-game days.
[*]Winter can last up to 7 in-game days, but players can finish it earlier in the Hotel in town.
[*]Added story popup after moving to the hotel in Winter.
[*]After loading the old save file, players start at Season 3 Day 1 (Spring).
[*]Prices in Shop are changing with each passing day. Increasing towards Summer and decreasing towards Winter.
[*]Added Fahrenheit temperature scale. You can enable it, by switching Units Type to Imperial (in Settings).
[*]Added new HUD indicators:
- Season,
- weather,
- temperature,
- days till next Season.
[*]Added a new summary window of Days and Seasons.
[*]Added rewards (Jars of gold displayed in the Tent) for finishing each full gold mining season (from Spring to Winter). Maximum amount of jars is 7.
[*]Added weather-related prompts.
[*]Added Achievements (full list below).
[*]Changed existing Tutorial to Reversed Tutorial. From now on players start with Tier 3 equipment and learn basic gameplay mechanics.
[*]Difficulty modes added (accessible from 'New Game' in Main Menu):
- Easy,
- Normal,
- Hard,
- Leaderboards (coming soon).
[*]Difficulty modes' features descriptions are visible when starting New Game.
[*]Difficulty level can't be changed during the game.
[*]Added menu with level difficulty choice for old saves.
[*]Added information about overriding save files.
[*]Added Prompt informing about the necessity to turn the engine on when not being able to drive. It does not disappear until the engine is turned on.
[*]New epilepsy warning popup window.
[*]Added Cancel button to Main Menu.
[*]Collector's Edition Upgrade content is now accessible from Main Menu.
[*]Added Left and Right Trigger button icons to Main Menu.
[*]Added "Back" button to Journal.
[*]Added possibility to switch Journal bookmarks on a gamepad.
[*]Pressing [A] button on Play in Main Menu will move the active selection to the window below.
[*]Updated localizations.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Stories Radar no longer locks when in Pickup Truck.
[*]Fixed menu background not blurring when changing controller buttons.
[*]DigTube UI fixes.
[*]Gamepad UI fixes.
[*]UI prompts fixes.
[*]Menu buttons UI fixes.
[*]Controls UI fixes (controller buttons should be displayed correctly after returning from Pause Menu).
[*]Added missing gamepad button icons (previously displayed as white squares).
[*]Journal gamepad fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Seasons description[/h1]
[b]Spring[/b]
[list]
[*]Big Repairs - If you haven't put your equipment to the hangar or transport storage space, you're in a bit of a hole... Everything that could be broken will be broken.
[*]Animal Attacks - From time to time an animal can attack your claim (Popup event). There is a chance that your employee will be attacked and will be inactive for a while (information will be displayed in the Workers tab on the laptop) or the animal can break your cables/hoses (you will need to replace them).
[*]Meltdown - Earth is still a bit frozen, so you need to use the ripper (Bulldozer's back) to cultivate the earth before digging. If the temperature is low, the earth should still freeze over time. If you would not use the ripper, you won't be able to dig.
[*]Prices - Regular prices in the shop. All prices will vary day to day across the season.
[/list]

[b]Summer[/b]
[list]
[*]High Temperature - What a blistering heat! Machines break faster.
[*]Fainting - Workers can faint and be inactive for a while.
[*]Prices - Higher prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Autumn[/b]
[list]
[*]Heavy Rain - Electrical equipment is breaking faster. Wash Plant is breaking faster because of the dense and wet earth. Vehicles have less traction.
[*]Storm - The Laptop is off (no signal).
[*]Thunderstruck - At the beginning of the storm, thunderstruck can hit your big generator. There is a chance for each part connected to break as a result.
[*]Prices - Regular prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Winter[/b]
[list]
[*]Permafrost - Earth is frozen. You need to use the ripper (Bulldozer's back) to cultivate the earth before digging. If you would not use the ripper, you won't be able to dig.
[*]Freeze - Vehicles are breaking way faster. When the temperature is very low, hoses can break if the connected equipment is turned off, but the water pump is still running. Workers can get sick and be inactive for a while.
[*]Fuel - Higher fuel usage.
[*]Prices - Lower prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Summary[/b]
When you try to end the gold mining season but left something outside the hangar, you will receive a prompt about not securing every breakable equipment.
A summary with all your stats will be displayed, after finishing the gold mining season at the Hotel (in the middle of Winter).
You won't be able to finish the season before the winter comes.
After ending the season there you will receive an additional small trophy (jar) with the amount of gold you've collected during the last gold mining season.

[h1]Achievements list[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/stats/451340/achievements

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We want to thank all players, who helped us past those 365 days and supported us. We wouldn't be here without you!

[h1]Now let's get digging![/h1]

notes.title: Anniversary Update Open Beta - Seasons, Achievements, Reversed Tutorial
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/221b70e10d839de5193ffb7cd51419c2efb51b72.jpg[/img]

[h1]Anniversary Update 1.5 Open Beta is here![/h1]
Try out Seasons, Achievements, Reversed Tutorial, and more before the release.

[b]Watch Teaser:[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZkwnWl2uBGA

[h1]How to switch to open beta branch:[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1346397630

[h1]What's new?[/h1]
[b]Four Seasons Cycle.[/b]
Experience harsh Alaskan Winter and get excited about new gold mining season with the first Spring breeze.
[b]Achievements.[/b]
Show off your gold mining experience with Steam achievements. Can you get them all?
[b]Reversed Tutorial.[/b]
Start with all the best toys and... see for yourself!
[b]And More![/b]
New Game difficulty levels, bug fixes, and other improvements.

[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1]
Open Beta branch is a voluntary option and it may not reflect the quality and content of actual Anniversary Update 1.5.
Save files from Open Beta version won't be transferred to a live build.
Machine Failures are disabled by default. You need to enable them in Settings/Game.

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Seasons - gameplay is now affected by weather conditions:
- Spring,
- Summer,
- Autumn,
- Winter.
(description of Seasons and weather conditions below)
[*]Spring, Summer, and Autumn last 7 in-game days.
[*]Winter can last up to 5 in-game days, but players can finish it earlier in the Hotel in town.
[*]Prices in Shop are changing with each passing day. Increasing towards Summer and decreasing towards Winter.
[*]Added new HUD indicators:
- Season,
- weather,
- temperature,
- days till next Season.
[*]Added a new summary window of Days and Seasons.
[*]Added rewards (Jars of gold displayed in the Tent) for finishing each full gold mining season (from Spring to Winter).
[*]Added weather-related prompts.
[*]Added Achievements (full list below).
[*]Difficulty modes added (accessible from 'New Game' in Main Menu):
- Easy,
- Normal,
- Hard,
- Leaderboards (coming soon).
[*]Difficulty level can't be changed during the game.
[*]Added Prompt informing about the necessity to turn the engine on when not being able to drive.
[*]New epilepsy warning popup window.
[*]Added Cancel button to Main Menu.
[*]Collector's Edition Upgrade content is now accessible from Main Menu.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Stories Radar no longer locks when in Pickup Truck.
[*]Fixed menu background not blurring when changing controller buttons.
[*]DigTube UI fixes.
[*]Gamepad UI fixes.
[*]UI prompts fixes.
[*]Menu buttons UI fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Seasons description[/h1]
[b]Spring[/b]
[list]
[*]Big Repairs - If you haven't put your equipment to the hangar or transport storage space, you're in a bit of a hole... Everything that could be broken will be broken.
[*]Animal Attacks - From time to time an animal can attack your claim (Popup event). There is a chance that your employee will be attacked and will be inactive for a while (information will be displayed in the Workers tab on the laptop) or the animal can break your cables/hoses (you will need to replace them).
[*]Meltdown - Earth is still a bit frozen, so you need to use the ripper (Bulldozer's back) to cultivate the earth before digging. If the temperature is low, the earth should still freeze over time. If you would not use the ripper, you won't be able to dig.
[*]Prices - Regular prices in the shop. All prices will vary day to day across the season.
[/list]

[b]Summer[/b]
[list]
[*]High Temperature - What a blistering heat! Machines break faster.
[*]Fainting - Workers can faint and be inactive for a while.
[*]Prices - Higher prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Autumn[/b]
[list]
[*]Heavy Rain - Electrical equipment is breaking faster. Wash Plant is breaking faster because of the dense and wet earth. Vehicles have less traction.
[*]Storm - The Laptop is off (no signal).
[*]Thunderstruck - At the beginning of the storm, thunderstruck can hit your big generator. There is a chance for each part connected to break as a result.
[*]Prices - Regular prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Winter[/b]
[list]
[*]Permafrost - Earth is frozen. You need to use the ripper (Bulldozer's back) to cultivate the earth before digging. If you would not use the ripper, you won't be able to dig.
[*]Freeze - Vehicles are breaking way faster. When the temperature is very low, hoses can break if the connected equipment is turned off, but the water pump is still running. Workers can get sick and be inactive for a while.
[*]Fuel - Higher fuel usage.
[*]Prices - Lower prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Summary[/b]
When you try to end the gold mining season but left something outside the hangar, you will receive a prompt about not securing every breakable equipment.
A summary with all your stats will be displayed, after finishing the gold mining season at the Hotel (in the middle of Winter).
You won't be able to finish the season before the winter comes.
After ending the season there you will receive an additional small trophy (jar) with the amount of gold you've collected during the last gold mining season.

[h1]Achievements list[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/stats/451340/achievements

[h1]Now let's get digging![/h1]



PS. Known issue on Open Beta Branch:
*Fueling doesn`t work, the issue will be fixed as soon as possible

notes.title: Game update roadmap
notes.notes:
[b]EVERY 2-3 DAYS, THERE WILL BE SMALL UPDATE ADDRESSING MOST IMPORTANT ISSUES.

PATCH #1: MONDAY (16.10) ~~ ETA: AFTERNOON / EVENING GMT+2

UPDATE ROADMAP:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/0/1484358860946856432/

FREE CONTENT UPDATES, WILL BE DELIVERED AFTER HOTFIXES AND PATCHES[/b]
--------------------
We are so happy to see how many of YOU decided to join our mining community.
I must admit, we never expected so much interest in our game (thank YOU!)

So, after receiving lots of feedback from YOU, we decided to change the schedule.
We will put 100% effort in patching the game, until YOU are happy with it.

I am truly sorry for all the inconveniences we caused – we will make things right as fast as we can.
After all we are gamers like YOU:)

notes.notes:
New Balance - We've added new balance to the game prices, fuel consumptions, etc.
Wave table - Wave table is now working properly. It should gather gold for you
FOV - We've added Field of View Option to the Graphics menu
Fuel amount in Jerrycan - We've added visual pointer to jerrycan, now telling us how much fuel is left
Fly me to the moon - Now, items on the ground shouldn't make pickup shoot itself to the sky.
Weather - We've slightly changed weather system, so now there should be more sunny weather than others
Magnetite Trailer - We've added magnetite trailer to the shop. Now, you can gather magnetite from separator and sell it in the factory.
Mobile Wash plant + Pickup bug - Now spawning mobile wash plant should not block pickup driving capabilities.
Gold exchange - We've added chart of the gold value history to the bank 
Caravan - we've added working caravan to the claims (nearby the tent), so you could sleep till morning and avoid working at night.
Longer Days - we've made days twice as long.
More Gold - There is now far more gold than before. You should see your progress of digging gold now.
Memory leak - Partially fixed. We've gotten rid of most of the memory leak. There is still some tweaks to do, but it should be much better now.
New Panning System - Right now, the gold amount and size in the gold pan is dependent on the weight of the gold you should acquire.
Gold Material - Now, gold should be golden again.
General Bug Fixes - We've fixed a lot of minor bugs that don't need to be showed.

notes.title: Changelog (rev. 4535)
notes.notes:
Part Shop - added new hints
Hog Pan mats - fixed bug, where you had to detach sluicebox to enable gold gathering on mats.
Wash Plant outline - Outline on wash plant system should be more visible.
Journal localization- We fully localized Journal to english
Azerty Keyboard- Added possibibility to keybind "Show Control" to let Azerty keyboard play the game "normally"
Totem Village - Fixed bug where you go through the map when getting close to the village building
Freeze streaming + circle - Added new way of dealing with world streaming
2 Monitory - Added support to multiscreen. Fixed GUI scaling
Map scaling - Fixed bug, where map showed wrong position on resolutions different than Full HD
Longer cables - We extended all kinds of cables
Longer hook ropes - We extended short hook ropes by one meter
Widoki - streaming - We improved level streaming, so you should see less terrain popups
Gold on the claim - We gave 4 times more gold to the claims
